class.name: HTMLRenderTarget
class.brief_description: Node that renders an HTML/CSS document to a reusable texture.
class.description: Produces a [Texture2D] from an [HTMLDocument] without drawing it directly. The current checkpoint produces a CPU placeholder texture.

signal.name: rendered
signal.description: Emitted after [method render_now] updates the texture.

signal.name: texture_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the output texture content changes.
